metadata.description: Review code changes produced by AI agents before they land: regression risk, performance defects, cloud-cost defects, readability, and convention adherence.

plugins.name: agent-work-review
plugins.description: Reviews agent-produced diffs across five dimensions — regression, performance, cloud cost (Cosmos DB and other metered services), readability, repo-convention adherence — spec-gated: work without a written specification is first specified via the bundled draft-spec skill (codebase analysis → goal analysis → confirmed spec), then reviewed.
